salary_management_system_learnings_appli: secret and variable are read separately

workflow uses inline Python and no Node-based actions
root_cause: Member Home was checking the explicit Body-Mind access marker, so the button became visible.
Body-Mind Connection page itself was still checking only workflow.body_mind_unlocked.
Therefore the button opened the page, but the page guard still blocked access.
testing_required: Finalized member: Admin Assessment page should show locked state and no Save/Generate buttons.
New test member: select Body-Mind activation, click Save and Generate Final Report, then Member Home should show Body-Mind.
Existing broken member: if activation request exists, Member Home should self-heal and show Body-Mind.
If activation was never selected, Body-Mind remains hidden until activated from Body-Mind Access Control.
business_rule: Body-Mind is NOT automatically unlocked based only on admin_completed/final_report_ready.
Admin final work must be complete first.
After final admin completion, Body-Mind becomes visible only when admin manually activates it.
Manual activation can happen from either approved path.
Final report download is not required; Save and Generate Final Report / admin_completed is sufficient prerequisite.
not_changed: Final report NSP data integrity fix
p0_fix: Added explicit body_mind_access member access marker separate from workflow flags.
Manual admin activation writes body_mind_access[user_id]=True and body_mind_unlocked=True.
Member Home checks explicit access marker as fallback.
Body-Mind Access Control visibility also reads explicit marker.
Logout simplified to one switch_page call after logout.
version_cleanup: Version appears next to HealthyMe in the header/topbar only.
client_rule_retained: No automatic unlock from finalization alone.
why: Prior fixes depended only on workflow fields, which could remain stale or be overwritten.
Explicit access marker ensures the manual admin action is honored even if workflow sync is stale.
hotfixes: Fixed NameError in Body-Mind Access Control by defining explicit_body_mind_access before stat grid usage.
Removed outdated Body-Mind v22 note captions.
Simplified logout to avoid switch_page plus refresh double behavior.
Retained v33 explicit body_mind_access fallback marker.
patched_body_mind_preview:
st.info("No members available.")
    st.stop()

selected = st.selectbox("Select member", [f"{m['id']} — {m['name']} — {m['email']}" for m in members])
member_id = selected.split(" — ")[0]
member = next(m for m in members if m["id"] == member_id)
wf = get_workflow(member_id)
explicit_body_mind_access = has_explicit_body_mind_access(member_id)
if explicit_body_mind_access:
    wf["body_mind_unlocked"] = True

# v31: repair stale review/instance status for finalized records without auto-unlocking Body-Mind.
if wf.get("admin_completed") or wf.get("final_report_ready") or wf.get("workflow_status") == "finalized":
    wf = sync_member_finalization_state(member_id, body_mind_unlock=None)

db = load_db()
body_response = db.get("body_mind_responses", {}).get(member_id, {})
admin_assessment = get_admin_assessment(member_id)

admin_assessment_saved = bool(admin_assessment) or bool(wf.get("admin_completed"))
admin_final_completed = bool(wf.get("admin_completed")) or bool(wf.get("final_report_ready"))

card_start()
st.subheader(member["name"])
st.caption(member["email"])
stat_grid([
    {"label": "Visibility", "value": "Visible" if (wf.get("body_mind_unlocked") or explicit_body_mind_access) else "Hidden", "note": "Member access"},
    {"label": "Activation", "value": "Requested" if wf.get("body_mind_activation_requested") else "Not requested", "note": "Admin selection"},
    {"label": "Admin Assessment", "value": "Saved" if admin_assessment_saved else "Not saved", "note": "Unlock prerequisite"},
    {"label": "Body-Mind", "value": "Completed" if wf.get("body_mind_completed") else "Not completed", "note": "Member progress"},

rollback_reason: v89 hybrid controls impacted desktop unexpectedly.
v89 hybrid mobile controls did not implement the intended pattern correctly.
This corrective build restores the last stable v88.1 Daily Log visual/mobile spacing state.
guard: Do not globally replace Streamlit input controls for mobile-only UX.
Future hybrid mobile input work must be implemented in a separate mobile-specific rendering path or only after explicit desktop approval.
No business logic changes are included in this rollback.
retained_from_v88_1: Recent Saved Days mobile label/value layout.
Body-Mind loader regression guard inherited from v87 lineage.
mobile_specific_spike_note: Streamlit does not provide a reliable server-side mobile-only widget branch without custom front-end handling.
This spike therefore restores dropdown controls that are acceptable on desktop and mobile instead of applying mobile-only controls globally.
test_urls: Auto mobile: open normally on phone; if diagnostic still says desktop, use the toggle.
important_note: This build uses public image URLs in CSV/admin forms. Production-grade upload persistence should move images to Supabase Storage or another persistent object store.
Existing CSV-based repository persistence is retained as per current app architecture.
reason: Streamlit Cloud could not load components.mobile_time_input_component.healthyme_mobile_time_input frontend assets.
Rollback avoids app-breaking component load failure.
native_time_note: True guaranteed native mobile time picker in Streamlit requires either a fully bundled custom component or a native/Flutter frontend.
Current build keeps stable Streamlit controls and aligns visual styling.
